atomicity: Malformed/admission/boundary failure publishes no blob facts and mutates no retained binding/catalog state. Native declaration failure publishes no declaration/schema/resource-reference prefix; independent core usage may survive only when its own exact key/flags proof is complete.
memory: Native child observed-RSS stop is not a hard heap/allocation guarantee. Parser/library allocations can overshoot before observation. Preflight bounds precede Go AST parse; encoded output cap after encoding is not an allocation bound. Record exact peak/observed samples and all stops.
source_policy: Only bounded committed Go source, ACL text and exact pinned core metadata; no application/client execution, connection, Redis/module implementation or metadata, RDB/AOF data bytes, script-body analysis or production imports.
measurement: Two fresh joined child passes; sorted canonical facts/citations/censuses/refusals identical. Metrics, output scans, source/binary/tool identities and joined teardown separate from deterministic payload. No cache, scale or quality extrapolation.
